_about: Sal, 2026-10-31; read by the server (server_items.gd _goals_data) and shown in the Journal. Camp-life and winter quests, same shape as data/items/starter_goals.json (see its _about for check kinds) with two additions: `needs_code` (true when a check kind or item chain does not exist yet: sea salt, new events worn_warmth, talked, moved_lit_night) and `after` may name goals from starter_goals.json. They teach the winter chain: render fat, smoke fish, dry berries, salt meat, keep a store, dress for the cold. The campfire pot, smoker and drying rack each have a build goal ahead of their first use (tools/goal_station_audit.py checks it); jerky and salted fish need sea salt (WATER_GATHER_SPEC.md). The metal path (charcoal through steel_tool, 21 Nov 2026, coordinator decision D-GOAL-1 under Dave's rule of 21 Nov) follows the camp and winter goals in the authored order, so the HUD still shows the winter chain first; it leads from the stone camp to copper, tin and bronze, iron, then steel, and its ore hints follow the ore layout and are reworded when that layout changes.

goals.title: Make a torch
goals.hint: Craft a Simple - Torch from a stick, a twine and a plant fibre, and carry it after dark.

goals.title: Dig clay
goals.hint: Craft a Wooden - Shovel (2 sticks; keep a stone in your pack), then dig where the ground is clay or under wet lowland soil. Clay makes pots, the smoker and the smelters.

goals.title: Hang a campfire pot
goals.hint: Fire 6 clay into a Clay - Pot at a lit campfire, then hold your hammer, press R, pick Campfire pot and click on the fire once its logs have burned down (3 sticks, 3 twine, the pot). Tallow and salt are made at it.

goals.title: Make a candle
goals.hint: Render 2 animal fat into Tallow at the Campfire pot, then open the inventory (I) and craft a Candle from 1 tallow and 1 plant fibre to light your shelter. Rabbits give no fat: hunt a deer, boar or badger for it.

goals.title: Build a smoker
goals.hint: Hold your hammer, press R and pick Smoker: 32 stones and 6 clay. Fish are smoked in it.

goals.title: Boil salt from sea water
goals.hint: Fire another Clay - Pot (6 clay) at the campfire, carry it to the sea and press E at the water's edge for sea water, then boil 2 sea water into Salt at the Campfire pot. Smoked fish, Jerky and Salted fish need it.

goals.title: Smoke a fish
goals.hint: Catch a fish and smoke it with 1 Salt in the Smoker. Salt is boiled from sea water at the Campfire pot.

goals.title: Build a drying rack
goals.hint: Hold your knife, press R and pick Drying rack: 8 sticks and 4 twine. Berries and jerky dry on it.

goals.title: Dry berries for winter
goals.hint: Dry berries on the drying rack so they keep: three times, 3 berries each.

goals.title: Make a food store
goals.hint: Hold your knife, press R and pick Wicker basket: 8 sticks and 4 twine. A Hide - Sack (2 hides, 1 twine) or a Storage jar (8 clay), built with the hammer, does too, and food keeps longer in any of them than in your pack. For the whole winter you will want a Storage barrel (hammer, with a Bronze - Chisel or better on the hand bar, R: 4 hardwood boards, 2 twine, 8 bronze nails).

goals.title: Store food for winter
goals.hint: A winter lasts 91 days and you eat about 2,500 kcal a day: about 2,000 apples' worth. Pick fruit in season (July to November) and dry, smoke or salt what will not keep, then open your food store with F and put food in until 1,000 are stored. Later a Storage barrel holds the most. Keeping apples, winter pears and dried or smoked food last into spring; cherries and plums do not.

goals.title: Store enough food for the whole winter
goals.hint: Keep storing food that keeps until 2,000 are put away, enough to eat through the whole winter.

goals.title: Make jerky
goals.hint: Dry 2 raw meat with 1 Salt on the Drying rack. Salt is boiled from sea water at the Campfire pot.

goals.title: Salt a fish
goals.hint: Cure a fish with 1 Salt at the Campfire pot for the winter store.

goals.title: Pack food that keeps
goals.hint: Hold 5 foods that keep: smoked fish, jerky, dried berries, salted fish, trail bread.

goals.title: Make a Bone - Needle
goals.hint: Open the inventory (I) and craft a Bone - Needle from 1 bone. With it and Thread (2 plant fibre) you sew hides into clothes.

goals.title: Dress for the cold
goals.hint: Wear a full hide set or better before winter: with the needle in your pack, sew hides and thread into a Hide - Hood, Hide - Cloak, Hide - Trousers, Hide - Boots and Hide - Gloves (a cloak takes 3 hides and 2 thread). That means hunting more than one rabbit.

goals.title: Hear a story at the fire
goals.hint: Talk with Edda at the camp in the evening, between 7 and 11 at night.

goals.title: Cross the camp at night with a torch
goals.hint: Walk 100 m with a lit torch after dark without stumbling.

goals.title: Save some charcoal
goals.hint: Burn firewood or logs on your campfire: the wood leaves charcoal in the fire. Take it out and keep it. Smelters and smithies burn charcoal or coal. Coal shows as dark outcrops on hillsides beside rivers, lakes and wet ground.

goals.title: Find copper ore
goals.hint: This is a journey, not a walk round camp. There is no copper by the sea: it lies inland, along rivers and streams toward the hills, richest round the foot of the mountains and on the first high ground. Expect well over a kilometre, so take food, water and a torch. Your campfire shows on the map (M), so you can find your way back. Follow a river upstream: green or blue-green stained pebbles in the stream bed mean copper further up. They get bigger and commoner until you reach green outcrops. Pick small pieces up with E; break bigger rocks with any pick or the Stone - Hammer. Nine pieces: three for the copper ingots now and six more for bronze later.

goals.title: Build a Primitive smelter
goals.hint: Hold your hammer, press R and pick Primitive smelter: 24 clay and 20 stones. Dig clay with a shovel where the ground is clay or under wet lowland soil.

goals.title: Smelt copper
goals.hint: Put copper ore in the Primitive smelter and charcoal or coal in its fuel slot (F), then press E to light it. Each copper ore gives a Copper ingot and burns one charcoal or coal.

goals.title: Build a Primitive smithy
goals.hint: Hold your hammer, press R and pick Primitive smithy: 24 stones, 10 clay and 2 logs. Keep charcoal or coal in its fuel slot; copper and bronze tools are made at it.

goals.title: Make a copper tool
goals.hint: At the Primitive smithy make a Copper - Pickaxe (3 copper ingots, 2 sticks) or another copper tool. Copper tools work faster and last longer than stone.

goals.title: Build a Tanning rack
goals.hint: Hold your knife, press R and pick Tanning rack: 6 logs and 4 twine. Hides are tanned into leather on it.

goals.title: Make a Scraper
goals.hint: At the Wooden - Workbench make a Scraper: a flint, a stick and a twine. Flint now and then comes away when you break a boulder with a pick. The scraper is kept when you scrape a hide.

goals.title: Tan leather
goals.hint: With the Scraper in your pack, scrape a hide on the Drying rack into a Scraped hide. Then tan it on the Tanning rack with 2 Tanbark and a full water container. Tanbark lies beside the logs when you fell an oak. Each hide makes a Leather.

goals.title: Build a Leatherworking table
goals.hint: Hold your hammer, press R and pick Leatherworking table: 4 logs, 4 sticks, 4 twine and 4 stones. Straps and leather goods are cut at it.

goals.title: Cut leather straps
goals.hint: At the Leatherworking table cut each Leather into 2 Leather straps. Every metal axe is bound with one, so cut both Leathers: 4 straps, one each for copper, bronze, iron and steel.

goals.title: Make every copper tool
goals.hint: At the Primitive smithy make the whole copper set: a pickaxe (3 ingots), an axe (2 and a leather strap), a hammer (2), a knife (1), a saw (2), a shovel (2), a hoe (2), a sickle (1), a scythe (2) and a chisel (1). That is eighteen copper ingots in all, one copper ore each, so find more copper ore. Each tool works faster and lasts longer than its stone one.

goals.title: Find tin ore
goals.hint: This is a journey, not a walk round camp. Tin is rarer than copper and farther inland still, below the high mountains, often beyond the copper. In streams it shows as small, glassy, dark brown to black pebbles, very heavy for their size; follow them upstream. At its source it is pale, speckled rock with white quartz veins and dark crystals. Plan a longer trip than for copper. Break it like copper ore, with any pick or the Stone - Hammer. Six pieces, each smelted with a copper ore, make the twelve bronze ingots the next steps need.

goals.title: Smelt bronze
goals.hint: Put copper ore and tin ore in the Primitive smelter together: each copper ore with a tin ore makes two Bronze ingots. Twelve covers a Bronze - Pickaxe (3), one ingot each for Bronze nails and Bronze hinges at the Primitive smithy, and 6 for the Improved smithy. Each ore burns one charcoal or coal, so the 12 ore take 12.

goals.title: Make a bronze tool
goals.hint: At the Primitive smithy make a Bronze - Pickaxe (3 bronze ingots, 2 sticks) or another bronze tool. A bronze pick can break iron rock.

goals.title: Build an Improved smelter
goals.hint: At the Primitive smithy make Bronze nails and Bronze hinges, then hold your hammer, press R and pick Improved smelter: 24 clay, 32 stones, 2 logs, 3 hides, 2 bronze hinges and 20 bronze nails. Its bellows let it smelt iron.

goals.title: Make every bronze tool
goals.hint: At the Primitive smithy make the whole bronze set: a pickaxe (3 ingots), an axe (2 and a leather strap), a hammer (2), a knife (1), a saw (2), a shovel (2), a hoe (2), a sickle (1), a scythe (2) and a chisel (1). That is eighteen bronze ingots in all; each copper ore smelted with a tin ore makes two, so with the pickaxe made, find eight more of each.

goals.title: Find iron ore
goals.hint: Iron is common. Rust-red iron stones lie along rivers and streams: pick the small ones up with E. Dig bog iron with a shovel in wet fen, marsh, swamp or bog ground. Bigger iron rocks and rusty outcrops need a bronze or better pick. Iron smelts once you have an Improved smelter.

goals.title: Smelt iron
goals.hint: Put iron ore and fuel in the Improved smelter, light it with E, then press E again to work its bellows: iron only smelts while someone works them. Two bog iron ore make 1 Iron ingot.

goals.title: Build an Improved smithy
goals.hint: Hold your hammer, press R and pick Improved smithy: 32 stones, 10 clay, 4 logs, 6 bronze ingots, 20 bronze nails and 2 bronze hinges. Iron tools are made at it.

goals.title: Make an iron tool
goals.hint: At the Improved smithy make an Iron - Pickaxe (3 iron ingots, 2 sticks) or another iron tool.

goals.title: Make every iron tool
goals.hint: At the Improved smithy make the whole iron set: a pickaxe (3 ingots), an axe (2 and a leather strap), a hammer (2), a knife (1), an Iron - Saw (2), a shovel (2), a hoe (2), a sickle (1), an Iron - Scythe (2) and a chisel (1). That is eighteen iron ingots in all.

goals.title: Build an Advanced smelter
goals.hint: Hold your hammer, press R and pick Advanced smelter: 40 bricks, 40 stones, 8 clay mortar and 6 iron ingots. Its windmill drives its bellows, and it makes steel.

goals.title: Make steel
goals.hint: Put iron ore in the Advanced smelter, drag 1 coal or charcoal onto its input for each iron ore (or each 2 bog iron ore) as carbon, put fuel in its hopper, and light it while the wind blows.

goals.title: Build an Advanced smithy
goals.hint: Make an Iron anvil at the Improved smithy (5 iron ingots, 1 log), and Iron nails and Iron hinges there (1 iron ingot each), then hold your hammer, press R and pick Advanced smithy: 48 stones, 12 clay, 6 logs, the Iron anvil, 30 iron nails and 4 iron hinges. Steel tools are made at it.

goals.title: Make a steel tool
goals.hint: At the Advanced smithy make a Steel - Pickaxe (3 steel ingots, 2 sticks) or another steel tool.

goals.title: Make every steel tool
goals.hint: At the Advanced smithy make the whole steel set: a pickaxe (3 ingots), an axe (2 and a leather strap), a hammer (2), a knife (1), a saw (2), a shovel (2), a hoe (2), a sickle (1), a scythe (2) and a chisel (1). That is eighteen steel ingots in all.
